_comment: The hand-kept workbook this repo is checked against, where each of its day
tabs lives in the Google Sheet, and what was reported off that tab at the
gid is the only thing that cannot be derived: it is the sheet's internal tab
id, and a tab name does not give it away. Read it out of the URL bar once
per tab and a delta row can then link straight at the cell it disagrees
with rather than at the top of a 100-row sheet. A tab with no gid still
appears; its rows just link to the workbook.
`reported` is the third reading of a day: the figures someone posted, with
the cut time they were taken at. It is what makes the population delta
readable instead of alarming — the sheet was cut at 23:00 and the line kept
testing until 02:00, so the controllers legitimately hold more units than
the sheet does, and the page should say that rather than leave a reader to
conclude the sheet is missing rows.
Never merged into either side. A figure a person posted and a figure a
script derived should stay distinguishable, for the same reason the release
page keeps its hand-compiled list beside the generated one.
